name: EN/CZ: 'Characters:' with English roles after dash, 'Shot n – 0:00-0:05', Location:/Camera: labels, English delivery '(laughing, off-screen)', 'Narrator (female):', 'Caption:' not spoken, only 3 windows
text:
Concept: "Babi online"
Characters: Libuše – grandma (75), Nela – granddaughter (16)

Shot 1 – 0:00-0:05
Location: Grandma's living room
Camera: close-up on the tablet screen, we see only grandma's forehead
Libuše: Nelinko, vidíš mě? Já tě vidím celou.
Nela (laughing, off-screen): Babi, vidím jenom tvoje čelo!

Shot 2 – 0:05-0:10
Camera: over the shoulder
Grandma tilts the tablet, now we see the ceiling.
Libuše: A teď?
Nela: Teď lustr. Hezký lustr.

Shot 3 – 0:10-0:15
Finally the whole face. Both laugh.
Narrator (female): Někdy stačí jen trocha trpělivosti.
Caption: Zavolejte babičce. Dneska.
lines: Nelinko, vidíš mě? Já tě vidím celou.
